title: Legal Capture
subtitle: Test your understanding of Legal Capture — the conversion of a living soul into a financialized corporate asset through the Birth Certificate, the corporate fiction, and the Cestui Que Vie 1666 Bond.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: Legal capture binds a living soul to a state-created corporate fiction at birth and draws on that bond for healthcare, loans, and statutory control. Seeing the distinction between the sovereign living soul and the paper entity removes the psychological foundation of that authority. Liberation requires systematic refusal of voluntary administrative programs and a return to organic law and sovereign self-governance.

questions.question: What is the primary objective of Legal Capture at the moment of a human birth?

options.label: A
options.text: The formal recognition of a sovereign human being as a member of a land-based community.
options.rationale: Legal Capture converts sovereign human beings into bound collateral by replacing organic law with statutory codes and administrative mandates.

options.label: B
options.text: The systematic conversion of a living human soul into a financialized corporate asset.
options.rationale: Legal Capture is the systematic conversion of a living human soul into a financialized corporate asset at the moment of physical birth.

options.label: C
options.text: The registration of the soul into a spiritual database for the purpose of religious tracking.
options.rationale: Legal Capture monetizes a living soul by binding that identity to a state-created corporate fiction, which is an administrative and commercial process.

options.label: D
options.text: The establishment of a protective legal trust to manage the child's future inheritance.
options.rationale: The trust created at birth is an instrument of jurisdictional dominion and resource extraction, not a protective inheritance for the child.

questions.hint: Consider the shift from a living being to a commercial item used for state debt.
